content:
I've been on the lookout for ultra-thin accessories to complement my everyday carry, and I really appreciate how tech companies and brands make their products so slim. I typically avoid anything that's too bulky or not well-designed. As a result, I've tried countless accessories, including battery packs, stands, magnetic cables, and many other types of products. In this article, I want to share a few accessories I absolutely love that are not only ultra-thin and portable but also versatile.

Check out my hands-on video where I'll demonstrate all the gadgets mentioned in this article and more. In the video, there are 11 small, slim accessories worth talking about!

This is a recent addition to my everyday carry, and the experience has been top-notch. The Snap Grip Stand is made by the same team that created the original Popsocket. It's impressive how they managed to make the product so slim. It's basically about as thick as the iPhone's camera bump. Key features include:

  • Equipped with a Popsocket-like ring for one or two-finger grip
  • Features a separate adjustable metal kickstand that rotates 350 degrees
  • Supports both portrait and landscape viewing
  • Double-sided magnetic design, meaning you can attach more MagSafe accessories on top of the stand

I still can't figure out how they managed to pack so many features into such a thin, light stand, but it's become a permanent fixture on my iPhone. It's so thin that you can wirelessly charge even with the accessory attached! Another plus is that because it's so slim, it doesn't make the phone wobble when placed on a table!

The Snap Grip Stand is currently available on the official website for $39.99 in four colors: black, green, light purple, and silver. The ring component is also sold separately for $29.99 in 18 colors—more than you can count. For any iPhone user, this product comes highly recommended.

This has always been a favorite of mine. On the surface, it looks like just another 3-in-1 charger for your Apple devices, but it's the build quality, versatile design, and value for money that really make it stand out. It includes:

  • MagSafe-compatible Qi2.2 25W charger
  • 5W Apple Watch charger
  • 5W AirPods charger
  • Foldable CNC aluminum design

This device is extremely compact and slim. The Kuxiu X40 Turbo can fold up to charge just your iPhone, unfold into a 3-in-1 charging stand, or lie completely flat for use. At its thinnest point, it's only 18mm, and when folded it's about the size of a palm. Best of all, it comes with a 45W power adapter needed for 25W fast charging, plus a hard case that fits all the accessories. It's truly an underrated product.

The Kuxiu X40 Turbo is available on Kuxiu's official website for $78 in five styles: gray, black, wood grain, orange, and cherry. It's the first charger that perfectly matches the Cosmic Orange iPhone right out of the box! At $78, you get the charger, braided cable, 45W power adapter, and a carrying case.

The next product is even more impressive. I absolutely love ultra-small, slim MagSafe battery packs. Large MagSafe batteries definitely have their place, but if I need to charge while using my phone, I'd rather pick a smaller-capacity battery so I can top up the phone without turning it into a two-pound brick in my hand. Currently, the thinnest and lightest MagSafe battery pack is the SolidSafe Air. Specs include:

  • 5,000mAh battery capacity
  • 6.8mm ultra-thin body
  • Supports up to 15W Qi2 wireless charging
  • USB-C output up to 20W
  • Can charge two devices simultaneously

I own three of these batteries, and no matter where I go, I always bring one along. My iPhone 17 Pro can no longer last a full day, so carrying this battery pack daily is a must for me. They're lightweight, have a premium look and feel, and come in several nice color options.

The SolidSafe Air 5K is available on BMX's website for $59 in three colors: black, silver, and gold. You can also opt for a two-pack or three-pack for a discount. For the next generation, my only hope is that if the thickness doesn't increase, they could swap the LED indicator for a small display screen!

For iPhone photography enthusiasts, or anyone who wants to shoot in well-lit conditions without lugging around bulky gear, this product is very interesting. The SnapPocket is a small, lightweight ring light that magnetically attaches to the back of the phone. It can also flip over so you get great lighting when using the front-facing camera. Features include:

  • Built-in 8 LED lights
  • Maximum brightness of 90 lumens
  • Four adjustable brightness levels
  • Flippable and MagSafe-compatible design
  • Built-in battery with USB-C charging support

From the specs, the SnapPocket is twice as bright as the iPhone's built-in flash, and provides a more stable light source, making it especially suitable for shooting video. Like all the other accessories, the key is portability and compactness. It fits in a pocket or any bag, and since it's MagSafe compatible, it can stay attached to the phone all day.

The ShiftCam SnapPocket Light is available on Amazon for $33 (using the promo code on the product page). It comes in three colors: black, blue, and gray. For anyone looking to improve their iPhone photography quality without spending too much or adding complex gear, this makes a perfect gift.

I mentioned this product before, but since I use it so frequently, I want to bring it up again. Everyone knows SSD prices are getting more and more expensive, but buying an external SSD is still far more cost-effective than buying more iPhone built-in storage. So whenever I want to shoot ProRes video, I definitely use the Lexar ES5 SSD. It magnetically attaches to the phone and has a built-in USB-C cable, so you can save directly to the SSD without taking up space on your iPhone. Specs include:

  • Read/write speeds up to 2,000MB/s
  • Supports USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 connection
  • Supports direct recording to 4K/120 fps ProRes
  • IP65 protection rating, 3-meter drop protection
  • Capacity up to 4TB

The design is another reason I'm drawn to it, and why I use it more often than other SSDs. It's small and lightweight, with slightly rounded corners, making it more comfortable to hold when using the phone.

The Lexar ES5 is available on Amazon, with the 1TB version starting from $199. Although the price is higher than a few months ago, it's still much cheaper than buying an iPhone with 1TB of built-in storage.

Summary

As mentioned above, check out my video where I'll demonstrate 11 small, slim products I think readers will love. These 5 are just my favorites among them. What I value most is minimizing the burden, and these accessories fit the bill perfectly. From the ultra-thin and practical Snap Grip Stand to the extremely useful Lexar SSD, each one is functional without forcing me to carry large, bulky accessories.

What do you think of these products? Have you tried any of them before? What's your favorite accessory in this category? Why not leave a comment below and let's chat.
